title: I think some people will look at this through a cynical lens- but hon...
transcript: We have to talk about this crazy theater news that just dropped as deadline is reporting that after this current revival of Glengarry Glen Ross, currently starring Kieran Culkin, Bob Odin, Kirk, and Bill Burr, they are going to replace this cast with an all female cast. And obviously we have had replacement cast that have deviated from the original casting, but never in my opinion, to this extreme. Like essentially they are opening a brand new revival of Glengarry Glen Ross immediately after this one closes. Like yes, it will be on the same set, and yes, the creative team is going to be the same, but the fact that it is an all female cast is going to make this feel like a very different revival. And I do wonder what this is going to mean for Tony eligibility as well. I imagine it won't be eligible for the Tony's, but I do also wonder if that will affect the caliber of actresses that they are able to get for this production. Like if they are able to get actresses on the level of Karen Cullen, Bob Odin, Kirk, and Bill Burr, then like yes, sign me up. But traditionally shows have had trouble getting big stars to sign on to replace since they won't be Tony eligible. But regardless, I am very interested to see how this all plays out.
